connector.name: Vibo MCP
connector.registryDescription: Vibo (vibodj.com) MCP - plan & manage event music: timeline, songs, ideas, questions, guests
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package vibo-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the chrischall account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: VIBO_EMAIL
env.description: Vibo account email (or use VIBO_ACCESS_TOKEN for SSO accounts)

env.name: VIBO_ACCESS_TOKEN
env.description: Captured x-token from a signed-in web.vibodj.com session (SSO alternative)

env.name: VIBO_REFRESH_TOKEN
env.description: Matching x-refresh-token so the session can renew
